title: 資料中心備援配電
titleEn: Redundant power distribution for data centers
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

stages.title: 負載與路徑
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成負載與路徑；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete loads and paths through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 盤點單電源與雙電源：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Inventory single and dual cords: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解盤點單電源與雙電源，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand inventory single and dual cords through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在機櫃清單標出單電源例外與所需轉移裝置介面。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Mark single-cord exceptions and transfer-device interfaces in a rack inventory. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在機櫃清單標出單電源例外與所需轉移裝置介面。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark single-cord exceptions and transfer-device interfaces in a rack inventory. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「盤點單電源與雙電源」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If inventory single and dual cords disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「盤點單電源與雙電源」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for inventory single and dual cords, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 盤點單電源與雙電源：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Inventory single and dual cords: principle
knowledge.text: 雙路上游供電無法自動使單電源設備具備雙路接入。
knowledge.textEn: Dual upstream power does not automatically give single-cord equipment dual input.

knowledge.title: 盤點單電源與雙電源：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Inventory single and dual cords: evidence
knowledge.text: 在機櫃清單標出單電源例外與所需轉移裝置介面。
knowledge.textEn: Mark single-cord exceptions and transfer-device interfaces in a rack inventory.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：一櫃 12 kW 雙電源負載正常平均由 A/B 各供 6 kW，但任一路失效後另一側須承接 12 kW。若把每側只按 6 kW 配置，兩路標籤不會產生備援。 可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 12 kW dual-cord rack normally takes 6 kW from each A/B path, but either 剩餘路徑 must carry 12 kW after the other fails. Rating each path at only 6 kW does not create redundancy. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「資料中心備援配電」的「盤點單電源與雙電源：建立模型」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出能源來源、導體、負載、回流與保護的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「微電網：守住晚高峰」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與隔離低壓模型的接線圖、電流方向、測點與時間戳的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Inventory single and dual cords: build the model” in “Redundant power distribution for data centers”. Draw the source, conductor, load, return and protection boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Microgrid: Protect the Evening Reserve” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for isolated low-voltage wiring diagram, current direction, measurement points and timestamps, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

knowledge.text: 正常分攤不等於故障承載， 剩餘路徑 要按故障後總負載計。
knowledge.textEn: Normal sharing differs from fault loading; the 剩餘路徑 must carry post-fault demand.

knowledge.text: 重算 12 kW 機櫃範例，連續增加機櫃直到首個支路越限。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute the 12 kW rack example and add racks until the first branch overloads.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：一櫃 12 kW 雙電源負載正常平均由 A/B 各供 6 kW，但任一路失效後另一側須承接 12 kW。若把每側只按 6 kW 配置，兩路標籤不會產生備援。 可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 12 kW dual-cord rack normally takes 6 kW from each A/B path, but either 剩餘路徑 must carry 12 kW after the other fails. Rating each path at only 6 kW does not create redundancy. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.
